findings.summary: per-scene vcpkg feature profiles made the development cache static and multiplied installs; one manifest-derived development-full superset now serves every scene while shipping keeps the exact static feature set
the shared development vcpkg paths and manifest feature set were still recomputed for every scene; build setup now reads and normalizes them once per command
selecting clang-cl in an existing MSVC CMake cache cannot work; compiler changes now replace only the registry-owned disposable scene tree after proving it is below native/
the shipping packager still carried unreachable dynamic and BOTH-backend branches after those shapes became invalid, and a static vcpkg triplet did not prove the application used the static CRT
the shipping packager rescanned CMakeCache.txt separately for each required setting; it now parses the cache once and reuses the normalized values

replacing the TypeScript package outright with TypeScript 7 broke bblitec's runtime AST API dependency; the native compiler and legacy compiler API now have separate package identities and both versions participate in the build stamp
the TypeScript build stamp ignored package-lock.json, so a dependency-lock change could leave dist marked current even though the installed type and compiler inputs had moved
generated renderer plans unconditionally emitted unused normalize and cross helpers, and feature-pruned native helpers and one conditional lambda capture produced avoidable clang-cl warnings

the offline shader pipeline generated DXIL, SPIR-V, and MSL for every host even though development validates one native target; target selection now emits only the host format by default and keeps all as an explicit portability check
binary shader cache hits overwrote identical deployed outputs, changing mtimes and forcing every native deploy step; cache publication now compares bytes before replacing an output
Windows development silently reduced validation to SDL_GPU when Dawn was absent; the default is now BOTH and an incomplete Dawn setup fails with the build command that supplies it

the Dawn wrapper omitted its copy_dxil_dll target and native deployment omitted the resulting validator even though the pinned D3D12 backend loads dxil.dll before dxcompiler.dll; build and deployment now carry the complete three-DLL runtime

the configure skip compared inputs to CMakeCache.txt even though CMake preserves that file's mtime when cache values are unchanged, causing every warm scene to serialize through vcpkg forever after a CMake edit; it now compares against CMake's refreshed cmake.check_cache generation marker
